task.title: Pool x runtime compatibility check before deployment advance
task.summary_zh: GAP P1 列為 DEP-004 但 sprint 7 沒派；grep 確認 services 與 governance 樹下沒有 pool/runtime compat check 實作。本任務在 DeploymentPlan 進入 RuntimeBinding 前增加 capital_pool 能力 × runtime 要求的相容性檢查，不通過則阻擋 advance。獨立 module，不修 DEP-001..003 公開 API。
acceptance: pool_runtime_compat.py exposes check_compatibility(capital_pool_id deployment_plan_id) returning CompatibilityResult dict with passed bool and rejection_reasons list
checks include: pool admissibility status equals active
pool jurisdiction matches runtime broker jurisdiction
DeploymentPlan service refuses advance when CompatibilityResult.passed is false (1-line hook)
test covers 1 pass + 5 fail scenarios (one per check) with pytest -q exit 0
